notes.title: need Reborn, Remake
notes.content:
For four years.

Watching the sun rise and set every day, and work like cold robot.
I often ask myself, what is the purpose of alive?
For the rice in my bowl? For my parents? Or  just for alive?
hesitation, confusion, failure.
Now, DREAM is only a dream.


I run by the river, I run in the mount forest, I sit in a Buddhist temple in the suburbs.
Most of my memories are: summer's watermelon, autumn's corn.
In the middle of the night, I have insomnia,.
And I dont know why, I feel relieved.
I looked at the shrimp in the fish tank, and then I looked at the game that can't be called a 'game'.
"Do something!"
Add something new and whatever, to make it look like a game.



Finally, thank you to those who have bought this, and wish everyone can have a better life.
Maybe three years later, I'll rewrite the story again?

notes.title: If by Life You Were Deceived
notes.content:
[b]Better to light one candle than to curse the darkness.[/b]


-------Alexander Pushkin

If by Life You Were Deceived


Don't be dismal,don't be wild!


In the day of grief,be mild:



Merry days will come,believe.



Heart is living in tomorrow;



Present is dejected here.



In a moment,passes sorrow;



That which passes will be dear.
